# ThirdParty/DotRecast

Vendored subset of [DotRecast](https://github.com/ikpil/DotRecast) (pinned commit
`5841f99e9881c05ca105079b25bb8faecf8b65a1`, tag `2026.3.1`, ZLib licence — see `LICENSE.txt`), backported
to net472 / C# 7.3 and compiled into `BetterBannerlordNavmeshing.dll`.

Do **not** hand-edit these files beyond the backport recorded in `NOTICE.md`; re-apply that backport when
re-syncing from upstream. `DotRecastBackport.cs` is ours (MathF/Clamp/Fill/IsFinite shims).
